check_docstrings: check all public object docstrings in the transformers repo for signature mismatches
check_auto_docstrings: check and optionally fix docstrings of @auto_docstring decorated classes and functions in model files
run_check_docstrings_cli: run the check_docstrings CLI with --fix_and_overwrite to auto-generate placeholder docstrings
match_docstring_with_signature: match a callable's docstring Args section against its Python signature and return old and new docstring text
fix_docstring: fix a callable's docstring by replacing the Args section to match its signature
generate_new_docstring_for_signature: generate a new docstring from a function or class signature with filled placeholder entries
